verdicts.reason: A is just the original pillarboxed: there are white empty bars down both sides because the green background and forest were not extended. That makes it an unadapted, unshippable copy, though the text, dividers and hierarchy are intact. B has the same white bars, and it also moves the cream divider up into the treeline as a stray line, drops the second divider, and pushes 'March 21' into the trees. Its headline runs to the canvas edges with no margin, so B is worse.
